_comment: ai-blocker-watch settings. repos: where closed issues are propagated to the issues they were blocking, and where the unowned-blocker alarm scans open issues. harness: how a waiting session is resumed; {session}, {cwd}, {prompt}, {home} and {zcode_builtin} (newest ZCode provider runtime file) are substituted per argument. ZCode headless needs a one-time CLI sign-in (zcode.cjs login) before its wakes succeed. alarm_*: the unowned-blocker alarm — an open issue blocking another open issue with no assignee, no `owner:` line, no open linked pull request and no activity for alarm_stall_hours gets one request-for-owner comment and a daily digest issue in alarm_digest_repo (chains alarm_depth_priority+ levels deep first); a tick runs the scan at most every alarm_interval_minutes and bounds it to alarm_max_nodes issue reads. Override the whole file with AI_BLOCKER_WATCH_CONFIG.
